note: The legacy redirect campaign registry remains empty and is not used by the current direct-link publication. Current observed identities are recorded separately from unconfirmed intent. No enrolled-report validation or authorized performance import exists. The measurement collector counts direct links; it never redirects customers. Unknown report values remain blank, not zero.

schema.entry: ledger/products.json entry ID (P-01..P-05), subject to separate intent and enrolled validation
schema.asin: 10-character identifier from a verified catalog record
schema.enabled: boolean; disabled campaigns refuse to redirect rather than sending an unverifiable click

history_note: Static campaign registry consumed by tools/redirect_server.py. Empty by design: a campaign key must point at a VERIFIED product identity, and none of the three requested items resolved to a catalog record, so no link and no campaign may be published yet (Flagged for Review F-06/F-07). Keys are static labels; the tracker rejects anything that looks per-visitor, because the Participation Requirements forbid associating a sub-tag or Associates reporting with a specific end user (rule R-08).

observation_schema.channel: report channel, not inferred from an order
observation_schema.eligible_sessions: nullable integer supplied by the report; never inferred from page views
observation_schema.clicks: nullable nonnegative integer supplied by the report
observation_schema.reported_orders: nullable nonnegative integer supplied by the report
